page_title: Magic Hour MCP | Connect Claude, Claude Code, Codex and ChatGPT

sources.entry: Magic Hour - AI video creation platform for text-to-video, image-to-video, lip sync, face swap, and production APIs. Use MCP setup or the ChatGPT plugin. #freemium

summary.name: Magic Hour MCP
summary.one_liner: A remote MCP server and ChatGPT plugin that lets Claude, Claude Code, Codex, or ChatGPT create and edit images, videos, and audio through Magic Hour's API tools.
use_cases: generate product images from a chat prompt
animate a still image or portrait into video
lip sync a video to audio
swap faces or remove backgrounds in photos
generate music or speech for a video
let an AI agent produce and download rendered media
summary.what_it_does: The page describes connecting Magic Hour to Claude, Claude Code, Codex, or ChatGPT via a custom MCP server at https://mcp.magichour.ai/ or through a ChatGPT plugin. Authentication uses OAuth, with a connector key created automatically after sign-in. Once connected, the agent can generate, edit, colorize, and remove backgrounds from images, create video from text or stills, lip sync, animate portraits, and swap faces. It can also generate music or speech and clone voices the user has permission to use. The agent uploads source files, calls the matching tool, and a wait tool polls the render until it finishes and returns signed download URLs.
notable: Works inside existing AI assistants via MCP, with OAuth and no API key to manage
Includes a ChatGPT plugin with a bundled create-with-magic-hour skill
Long renders are handled by a wait tool that returns exact signed download URLs
Supports image, video, and audio generation from one connector
caveats: Availability of the ChatGPT plugin and custom MCP depends on ChatGPT plan, workspace, role, and region
Renders take time; the agent must wait for completion
Pricing details and credit costs are not stated in the page text (page is listed as freemium in the directory)
